article.title: Chennai suburbs battle civic issues even as real estate prices rocket

records.detail: Cyclone Mandous inundated several areas of the municipality, with no channel for the water to flow due to encroached outlets towards Porur Lake.
records.source_title: Chennai suburbs battle civic issues even as real estate prices rocket

records.detail: Residents opposed the merger of the local village panchayat with the Mangadu Municipality due to its poor handling of flood issues in nearby Jeeva Nagar.
